decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 3 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 4 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 6 - No advertisment shall be sited or displayed so as to obscure, or hinder, the ready interpretation of any road sign, railway sign or aid to navigation by water or air so as to otherwise render hazardous the use of any highway, railway, waterway ( including any coastal waters) or aerodrome (civil or military).
Condition : 7 - The street number of the property shall be displayed on the fascia hereby approved.

Condition : 8 - REASON FOR APPROVAL

It is considered that the proposed fascia, and side signs would contribute to enhance the viability and vitality of the local neighbourhood shopping parade and  would not have impact upon the character and appearance of the existing mixed use building and the street scene due to the siting, size, scale, design, and illumination of the signs , would not result in light pollution and advertisement signs, would not result in the  proliferation, of   signs and would be in conformity with the local parade and area of the retail units facades and the Staines Road. The advertisement signs would not have adverse detrimental impact upon the  visual amenity of the area. On balance the proposed fascia signs is in accordance with the Adopted Unitary Development Plan(December 2003) Policies ENV - B.1.4 (Advertisements), S.1.1 (Main Shopping Area)., S.2.1 (Minor Neighbourhood Centres and Key Local Parades)  of the London Borough of Hounslow  Council., and is generally compliant with Council's Supplementary Guidance. It is considered that where the advertisement signs are not compliant  there are no undue adverse detrimental effects resulting from this.
description: Installation of various illuminated and non-illuminated signs to existing building.
